description: User can open the application and reach the primary page without runtime errors.
acceptance_criteria: No unhandled error appears in UI or console.
steps: Open the app URL in browser.
Verify main page renders and no crash occurs.
evidence_hint: Screenshot of loaded page + startup log

description: User can complete the primary happy-path action.
acceptance_criteria: Primary action can be executed end-to-end.
Success state is shown to user.
steps: Navigate to the main interaction screen.
evidence_hint: Step-by-step result notes or video clip

description: Validation and user-visible error handling work for invalid input.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid input triggers clear, user-facing feedback.
App remains usable after validation failure.
steps: Verify app remains usable after error.
evidence_hint: Screenshot of validation message and recovery path

description: Core UI remains readable and usable on mobile width.
acceptance_criteria: No clipping/overlap in key screens at mobile viewport.
steps: Verify no text overlap or overflow.
Verify primary buttons are reachable and readable.
